text:
morgan: Hey design — launching next Tuesday. We need a short motion slate + modular benchmark slide kit for the webinar and a small social clip. Timeline: final assets by Monday EOD. Can you confirm capacity?
leah: On it. What's the scope for the benchmark slides? Single hero chart or multiple variants?
morgan: Need 3 chart types: latency vs cost sparkline, throughput heatmap, and a comparative table (hosted vs dedicated vs private). Also 1 hero static + 1 15s motion slate for social. Keep brand guardrails.
samir: Also can we get an edit-friendly Figma file with components + tokens? Sales will want to edit numbers per region.
leah: Yes — I'll output a componentized Figma and provide PNG/SVG exports. Any animation notes for the 15s clip?
tess: Motion idea: animate the sparkline growing, then flip to the table, then a 3-second end card with CTA. Keep tempo soft, no heavy camera moves. :sparkles: 
diego: FYI — include accessibility color passes (contrast ratios) for all color variants. If we use overlays, make sure text is 4.5:1.
leah: Noted. Will run contrast checks and include alt-text copy in the asset package.
morgan: Brand checklist: use primary palette only, logo lockups per spec, no drop shadows for charts, and use our type scale. Link to guardrails: https://company.docs/redwood/brand/guardrails
samir: Can you include export presets? Naming convention we use:
```
redwood_bench_<variant>_<size>_<v1>.png
redwood_bench_motion_<15s>_<web>.mp4
```
Also SVGs for charts and a layered Figma for regional edits.
leah: Great — I'll add those presets to the Figma file and handoff doc.
morgan: One more ask — include a 16:9 webinar slide template, a 4:5 social crop, and a square thumbnail. Keep main copy short: "Inference that scales — less cost, lower latency". Sales wants a short bulleted subline to be editable.
tess: I'll prepare motion assets at 1080p for motion and export web-optimized MP4 + bgm-free versions. Need a brief for voiceover? or just title card?
morgan: No VO for launch — just animated caption + CTA. We'll add VO later if needed.
diego: tagging brand-bot for automatic QA on color tokens.
brand-bot: automated-check: color-contrast OK for primary palette on default samples, font usage matches H1/H2 tokens, 2 issues found: one table row uses accent-blue-100 (low contrast) and one PNG export missing transparency flag. Report: https://ci.redwood/brand-check/1852234567
leah: Thanks — fixing the table row and re-exporting PNGs with alpha.
samir: Who will handle translations/localization variants for APAC copy?
morgan: Growth will own copy localization; samir, can you coordinate with localization next week to swap numbers? We'll need language-safe card layout.
samir: Yep — will start a localization ticket and share placeholder text.
tess: Quick question on fonts: do we embed webfont or convert to outlines for motion renders?
leah: For motion, convert headings to outlines, keep body as font to allow edits in Figma.
morgan: Perfect. Please upload final package to the #launch-assets bucket and post the link here when ready. Also tag @growth to review.
leah: Plan: initial Figma frames by Friday, motion first pass by Sunday, final exports Monday AM. Will post progress updates here.
morgan: Awesome — thank you team. :rocket: 
leah: If anything blocks, I'll ping product for final numbers.
